subject: Drifting Hazard - Richelieu River and Northern Lake Champlain - Sainte-Antoine-sur-Richelieu
text:
Drifting Hazard - Richelieu River and Northern Lake Champlain - Sainte-Antoine-sur-Richelieu
Partially submerged tree 45 centimetres in diameter and visible 30 centimetres above the surface reported adrift in the vicinity of 45 47.4N 073 09.8W at 271830 UTC Oct 2026.
